pathbound.title: Choose your path
pathbound.subtitle: This choice is made once per world and cannot be changed later.
pathbound.waiting: The world host is choosing the difficulty...
pathbound.waiting.server: Waiting for an operator to choose the world difficulty...
pathbound.waiting.hint: Server admin: run "op <name>" in the server console and the chooser opens for that player, or set the difficulty right away with "pathbound mode set <id>".
pathbound.desc.classic: Walk the familiar road: the world as it was made, at your own pace. A good choice for a first journey.
pathbound.desc.trial: Take the harder road: this world sets tougher rules and asks more of you. For those who seek a challenge.
pathbound.confirm.title: Play in %s mode?
pathbound.confirm.text: The difficulty is chosen once for this world and cannot be changed from the game.
pathbound.configuration.defaultMode.tool: Difficulty id for a world that has none yet. "none" shows the chooser on first join.
pathbound.cmd.choose: Difficulty choice cleared; the host can choose again.
